title: iron RNG
description: Adds unique rarity levels (Broken, Rare, Epic, Legendary) and randomized stats to Iron Golems.
body:
Iron RNG is a lightweight modification that introduces a rarity system for Iron Golems. Every time a golem is spawned, it receives a random tier and adjusted attributes, making each defender unique.

Features:
Interactive Inspection: Right-click an Iron Golem to view its current rarity, health, damage, and speed in the chat.

4 Rarity Tiers:

Broken (Decreased stats)

Rare (Standard plus)

Epic (High performance)

Legendary (Maximum power)

Randomized Attributes: Health, Attack Damage, and Movement Speed are calculated based on the assigned rarity.

Compatibility: Designed for Forge 1.20.1.

Usage:
Simply use standard spawn methods or the /summon iron_golem command. The attributes and rarity will be applied automatically. To check a golem's stats, just right-click it
